description: Edits one or more supplied images using a text prompt. For prompt-only creation use generate_image. Costs credits; returns a project id for wait_for_image_project. Model eligibility depends on the account plan. When the user has not chosen a model, resolution or count, omit them; the API picks eligible defaults for the plan. Preserve an explicit model, resolution or count; if the plan can't use it, explain the limit and offer a supported option before changing it. Check the chosen model's input limits; never drop references. Before choosing settings, read get_account_info and the current parameter constraints. A listed model, resolution, duration or count is not necessarily available together or on this account. Preserve explicit requirements and all supplied inputs; explain a genuine block instead of submitting an incompatible request. Account balance alone does not prove a request is affordable. Use the named attachment fields first for ChatGPT files. Ask which file goes where if their roles are unclear. If a file fails, ask the user to attach it again and keep the requested settings.

aspect_ratio.description:
Keep an aspect ratio the user explicitly requests. Otherwise, choose by where the output will be used: 9:16 for TikTok, Reels, Shorts, Stories or a phone screen; 16:9 for YouTube, a website, slides or TV; 1:1 for an Instagram or Facebook feed post or a profile picture. If the user names a use but you can't tell its shape, ask. With no new use or shape requested, keep `auto` to match the source image.

The aspect ratio of the output image(s). If not specified, defaults to `auto`. Ignored for `krea-2` and `flux-2-klein` when an input image is provided; the output keeps the source image's aspect ratio.

assets.description: Provide the assets for image edit

image_file_paths.description:
The image(s) used in the edit, maximum of 10 images. This value is either
- a direct URL to the file. The URL path must end in a supported file extension.
- `file_path` field from the response of the [upload urls API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls).

See the [file upload guide](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls#input-file) for details.

image_count.description: Number of images to generate. Maximum varies by model. Defaults to 1 if not specified.

name.description: Optional project name for identifying this output. Omit to use the API's default project name.

resolution.description:
Maximum resolution (longest edge) for the output image.

**Options:**
- `640px` — up to 640px
- `1k` — up to 1024px
- `2k` — up to 2048px
- `4k` — up to 4096px
- `auto` — **Deprecated.** Mapped server-side from your subscription tier to the best matching resolution the model supports

**Per-model support:**
- `flux-2-klein` - 640px, 1k, 2k
- `flux-3-klein` - 640px, 1k, 2k
- `gpt-image-2` - 640px, 1k, 2k, 4k
- `gpt-image-2.5-flare` - 640px, 1k, 2k, 4k
- `krea-2` - 640px, 1k
- `nano-banana` - 640px, 1k
- `nano-banana-2-lite` - 640px, 1k
- `nano-banana-2.1` - 640px, 1k, 2k, 4k
- `nano-banana-pro` - 1k, 2k, 4k
- `qwen-edit` - 640px, 1k, 2k
- `qwen-image-2.1` - 640px, 1k, 2k
- `seedream-v4` - 640px, 1k, 2k, 4k
- `seedream-v4.5` - 640px, 1k, 2k, 4k
- `seedream-v5-flash` - 640px, 1k, 2k
- `seedream-v5-pro` - 640px, 1k, 2k

Note: Resolution availability depends on the model and your subscription tier.
